test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the cube which cannot be formed on folding the given sheet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2be2557adfe10ed6e89b80b592ec552c7308725bacc600c80540094550e677a8.png]
solution:
On folding the cube, the following faces are opposite to each other:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5513b46c9ac484b28c1621844cf33a57ad2365d6024fa9c28252fbe8e717e6cf.png] 

1. '+' is opposite to the sign '%'. 

2. '-' is opposite to the sign '!'.

3. '0' is opposite to the sign '@'. 

As we know that, no two opposite surfaces are adjacent to each other.

Option 1: + and % are adjacent to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2137aae71fe093f68192c61be7b358cec52afe6f9fbe7b581052060429fbbc6.png] 

∴ The cube in option 1 cannot be made on the given unfolded cube in the question figure, as two opposite sides are adjacent to each other.

Option 2: No opposite surfaces are adjacent to each other.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5513b46c9ac484b28c1621844cf33a57ad2365d6024fa9c28252fbe8e717e6cf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b22f1f7970366a6abcae12179d77a3393001191f953a6500e16fde06d73dbbf9.png] 

∴ The cube in option 2 can be made on the given unfolded cube in the question figure.

Option 3: No opposite surfaces are adjacent to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5513b46c9ac484b28c1621844cf33a57ad2365d6024fa9c28252fbe8e717e6cf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/210e5c6dc3d86b6187db41fb15f75dabe20f953f79b8d89b361482714d2b9f21.png] 

∴ The cube in option 3 can be made on the given unfolded cube in the question figure.

Option 4: No opposite surfaces are adjacent to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5513b46c9ac484b28c1621844cf33a57ad2365d6024fa9c28252fbe8e717e6cf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bba189fa99edb6aae65c33b89e042727382c370dbd47686f2f22f6ce58eae05.png] 

∴ The cube in option 4 can be made on the given unfolded cube in the question figure.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__

The opposite surface of the open dice/cube can be found by the below methods:-

1. Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.

2. No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners.
